title: Vault Chest Key

sources.title: The Counting House

summary: Unlocks the gold-only Wooden Chest outside the grates in the Counting House.

fields.Use: Unlock the Wooden Chest outside the grates. The chest inside near safe 1 uses a different lock.
fields.Acquisition: Wooden Desk at X −707, Y 851 in the High Security Vaults according to the key’s item page.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
